_comment: The P4 launch card's minutes per step (scripts/t64_card.py), each with its basis. 'measured' names the P1 session and step it was read from (L4, Cascade Lake, docs/spend_ledger.md); nothing here has run on an H100, whose host is Sapphire Rapids, so a measured row is a basis, not a forecast. 'estimate' is not measured anywhere (the 28 Oct 2026 card). The compiled groups are not in (adviser's ruling 2 of the tenth 9 Nov 2026 paste).

setup_h.basis: estimate: write gate, deploy, preflight, bootstrap with XAttention (28 Oct 2026 card); Flex waiting time is not counted, the VM is not running

suite_record_min.basis: adviser's ruling 1h dated 10 Nov 2026: about 20 min. The L4 rehearsal's record took 9 min 41 s for the suite and the S8 run after it (attempt 1); the bootstrap bounds it at SUITE_RECORD_MIN, 25. First boot only: on Spot, block b1

teardown_h.basis: estimate: logs and manifests pull, delete, cleanup check (28 Oct 2026 card)

masks.basis: estimate: each XAttention cell P2 recorded, untimed, on the Triton path

host_components.basis: measured: T3.2d step 5, L4 (20, an estimate, on this card until 9 Nov 2026)

ground_truth.basis: the hold, then measured: T3.2d step 9 (eager group, traced pass included), L4, then estimate: the Kineto export
